← Historical Coat of Arms

Image credits

Historical arms, emblems and seals from Wikimedia Commons. The period and notes identify the representative version used. Many SVGs are modern drawings of historical designs. Readable entity-name lettering in Latin script is removed where present; other artwork and mottos remain. Each image retains its individual licence, with changes listed below.
